answer: Dawn–Jetty Mirror gating: each new agent gets a 48h probation whose action timestamps are summarized as inter-arrival quantiles and a phase histogram. Admission requires its shape to diverge from the mirror of local /24 traffic during dawn lulls, while bursts at the jetty ingress must not exceed the neighborhood envelope. Identities with near-identical autocorrelation spectra are clustered and throttled. A sybil farm must either wait out lulls and stagger schedules—costing real time and orchestration—or reveal a correlated timing fingerprint and lose throughput.
